messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
I’m not able to pull live data from an external source, but I can give you a quick rundown of the Canadian public holidays that typically create long weekends in 2023.  (Keep in mind that some provinces and territories observe additional holidays, so you may want to double‑check the specific dates for your province.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Typical Long‑Weekend Impact |
|-------------|---------|-----------------------------|
| **January 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | 1‑day holiday; no long weekend unless you take a day off. |
| **January 2** (Monday) | Observed New Year’s Day (if you’re in a province that observes it) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Jan 1–3). |
| **January 16** (Monday) | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | 3‑day weekend (Jan 14–16). |
| **February 20** (Monday) | Louis‑Riel Day (Manitoba) | 3‑day weekend (Feb 18–20). |
| **March 20** (Friday) | Good Friday | 3‑day weekend (Mar 18–20). |
| **March 23** (Monday) | Victoria Day (most provinces) | 3‑day weekend (Mar 21–23). |
| **May 29** (Monday) | Memorial Day (most provinces) | 3‑day weekend (May 27–29). |
| **July 1** (Saturday) | Canada Day | 3‑day weekend (Jun 30–Jul 2) if you take the following Monday off. |
| **September 4** (Monday) | Labour Day | 3‑day weekend (Sep 2–4). |
| **October 9** (Monday) | Thanksgiving (most provinces) | 3‑day weekend (Oct 7–9). |
| **November 7** (Monday) | Remembrance Day (observed in some provinces) | 3‑day weekend (Nov 5–7). |
| **December 25** (Monday) | Christmas Day | 3‑day weekend (Dec 23–25). |
| **December 26** (Tuesday) | Boxing Day (observed in some provinces) | 3‑day weekend (Dec 24–26). |

**Quick Tips for Your App**

1. **Province‑Specific Holidays** – Add a lookup table that maps each province/territory to its unique holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario vs. Louis‑Riel Day in Manitoba).
2. **Observed Dates** – Some holidays that fall on a weekend are observed on the following Monday. Make sure your logic accounts for that.
3. **User Preferences** – Allow users to toggle whether they want to see “official” holidays only or also include provincial/territorial observances.

If you need the exact dates for a particular province or want to confirm any changes for 2023, you can cross‑reference the official government calendars or use a public‑holiday API that provides Canadian data.
